ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
ለአብዳን: አብድ — to fools (ለ- + plural አብዳን of አብድ)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants')
በኴሉ: ኵሉ — in all, to all (በ- + ኵሉ; variant spelling ኴሉ)
ዘከርዋ: ዘከረ — they mentioned her (3mpl perfect, G, 'remember, mention' + -ዋ 3fs object suffix)
ለሊሃ: ለሊሃ — she herself (emphatic pronoun, 3fs; the masculine is ለሊሁ)
ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ)
አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
መከይደ: መከይድ — tread, footstool (?) (noun, construct; from ከይደ 'tread'; uncertain)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
ለጽሙእ: ጽሙእ — to the thirsty (ለ- + adjective used as noun)
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
ፈተወ: ፈተወ — he wished, desired (3ms perfect, G)
በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
ትሖር: ሖረ — that she go (3fs, after ከመ; the imperfect shape ትሖር)
ትስማዕ: ሰምዐ — that she may hear (3fs subjunctive, after ከመ)
ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
ኆልቈ: ኆልቍ — number, count (noun, accusative ኆልቈ; ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'without number')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
